admission_red.assertion: Discord could not atomically admit and replay the existing CLI workflow with its conversation binding and acknowledgement.

private_destination_red.assertion: Absence of a guild was accepted without positive owner-only DM verification.

verified: CLI and Discord use the same transaction-level admission implementation, preserving provider pins, PR-only ceilings, canonical aliases and immutable request replay.
Discord admission commits the request, job, owner/conversation/workflow binding and queued acknowledgement atomically. An injected acknowledgement insert failure rolls all new records back.
Discord identity is supplied as immutable bot/owner/channel/message IDs; message edits and destination changes cannot replay an old response as a new command.

The adapter requires configured bot/owner identity and a positive transport-provided owner-only DM verification flag before target lookup or state creation. Exact GitHub PR URL grammar rejects spoofed hosts, prose and extra authority flags.

The production adapter rechecks the GitHub write grant on replay and uses shared target validation for new requests. A scripted-GitHub/real-Git test replays after target closure and refuses a revoked grant.
Conversation selection is scoped to owner/bot/channel; multiple bound workflows require an explicit selector rather than whichever message arrived last.

A subprocess exits immediately after committed admission; restart recovers the original response. Concurrent acknowledgement claims permit only one attempt and persist uncertainty before transport send. Confirmed message receipts are immutable and origin-bound.
limits: The Discord gateway, owner-command/help registry, Slack parity entry and outbound transport are not connected to this backend yet. No live !autoship availability is claimed.
The DM verification flag must be derived from actual Discord channel metadata by that future gateway adapter; tests supply controlled metadata and do not validate live Discord access.
This binding records workflow routing only. Owned-workspace native session binding, ordinary coding follow-ups, stage-boundary serialization, provider handoff and control commands remain open.
Queued-ack draining, uncertain-send history reconciliation, retry/rebind controls and durable progress/deployment updates remain open. No exactly-once platform delivery claim is made.
No production rollout, live Discord/native acceptance or required fault/unattended soak has completed.
